Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Montag & Caldwell Has Raised Holding by $29.40 Million; Brookstone Capital Management Lowered Its Holding in Chevron New (CVX) as Share Value Declined 
April 17, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers 
Montag & Caldwell Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 26.73% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Montag & Caldwell Llc bought 173,959 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 824,786 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $139.58M, up from 650,827 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Montag & Caldwell Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $900.51 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.94% or $1.65 during the last trading session, reaching $177.48. About 7.55 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Brookstone Capital Management decreased its stake in Chevron Corp New (CVX) by 90.98% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Brookstone Capital Management sold 48,116 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.26% with the market. The institutional investor held 4,770 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $597,000, down from 52,886 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Brookstone Capital Management who had been investing in Chevron Corp New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $230.97B market cap company. The stock increased 0.17% or $0.21 during the last trading session, reaching $120.91. About 730,044 shares traded. Chevron Corporation (NYSE:CVX) has risen 7.88% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.67% the S&P500.
